usage: audit_sleep_dataset_compatibility.py [-h] [--sleep-edf SLEEP_EDF]
                                            [--isruc ISRUC]
                                            [--features FEATURES]
                                            [--split SPLIT]
                                            [--max-files MAX_FILES]
                                            [--report REPORT]

Audit Sleep-EDF and ISRUC-Sleep files before cross-dataset experiments. Run
from the root of the Sleep-Stage-Prediction project: python
scripts/audits/cross_dataset/audit_sleep_dataset_compatibility.py --sleep-edf
data/raw --isruc data/external/isruc --features
data/features/sleep_edf_features.csv --split
data/features/participant_split.csv The script reads metadata and annotation
summaries only; it does not preprocess signals, train models, or modify any
source files.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sleep-edf SLEEP_EDF
                        Root containing Sleep-EDF files
  --isruc ISRUC         Root containing ISRUC files
  --features FEATURES   Existing feature CSV
  --split SPLIT         Participant split CSV
  --max-files MAX_FILES
                        Number of signal files to inspect for each dataset
  --report REPORT       JSON report path

usage: audit_sleep_dataset_compatibility_v2.py [-h] [--sleep-edf SLEEP_EDF]
                                               [--isruc ISRUC]
                                               [--features FEATURES]
                                               [--split SPLIT]
                                               [--max-files MAX_FILES]
                                               [--report REPORT]

Audit Sleep-EDF and ISRUC-Sleep compatibility before cross-dataset
experiments. This is a read-only audit of source data. For ISRUC .rec signal
files, the script creates a temporary hard-link with an .edf suffix in the
same folder so MNE can read the EDF-formatted content. The original file is
not renamed or modified. Run from the project root, for example: python
scripts/audits/cross_dataset/audit_sleep_dataset_compatibility_v2.py --sleep-
edf data/raw --isruc data/external/ISRUC-Sleep-I --features
data/features/sleep_edf_features.csv --split
data/features/participant_split.csv --max-files 101 --report
results/dataset_compatibility_audit_v2.json

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sleep-edf SLEEP_EDF
                        Root containing Sleep-EDF PSG and hypnogram files
  --isruc ISRUC         Root containing ISRUC .rec and annotation files
  --features FEATURES   Existing Sleep-EDF feature CSV
  --split SPLIT         Existing participant split CSV
  --max-files MAX_FILES
                        Maximum signal files and Excel files to inspect per
                        source; use 0 to inspect all
  --report REPORT       Output JSON report path

usage: audit_sleepedf_isruc_v3.py [-h] --sleep-edf SLEEP_EDF --isruc ISRUC
                                  [--features FEATURES] [--split SPLIT]
                                  [--report REPORT]

Robust, read-only audit of Sleep-EDF Expanded and ISRUC-Sleep Cohort I. This
version fixes the MNE read_annotations API issue, identifies the duplicate
alternate-named recording in ISRUC subject 65, and parses ISRUC annotation
files without assuming Excel headers are consistent. It does NOT train a model
or modify source data. Run from the project root: python
scripts/audits/cross_dataset/audit_sleepedf_isruc_v3.py \ --sleep-edf data/raw
\ --isruc data/external/ISRUC-Sleep-I \ --features
data/features/sleep_edf_features.csv \ --split
data/features/participant_split.csv \ --report
results/dataset_compatibility_audit_v3.json

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sleep-edf SLEEP_EDF
  --isruc ISRUC
  --features FEATURES
  --split SPLIT
  --report REPORT

usage: capsule.py [-h] {create,unpack,verify} ...

Create and verify an offline source-training capsule; no upload is performed.
Only explicit code/configuration paths, the frozen split, and prepared Sleep-
EDF train/validation stores enter the archive. Test and external epoch data do
not.

positional arguments:
  {create,unpack,verify}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
